chapter.verse: Migilote eng kei in la, amaute tawh kikhawl kei in.
Amaute in tatsiat ding bek ngaihsun uh a, thusia bekbek genin nei uh hi.
Pilna tawh inn kilam a, ngaihsut siamna tawh inn kip hi.
Thu ngaihsut theihna a omna inn sungah, ahoih amanpha nate a dimin om hi.
Thahatna sangin pilna hoihzaw a, thakhauhna sangin thutheihna hoihzaw hi.
Geel siamna tawh galte kizo a, ngaihsut siamnate tawh gualzawhna kingah hi.
Pil kampauna in mihaite’ theih zawh dingin thuk lua a, mihon lakah mihaite in thu gen ngam lo uh hi.
Thusia lamsang a deih mite, thusia bawl mi kici hi.
Mihaite’ vaihawmna in khialhna bek piangsak lel a, mi a simmawh theite, midangte in mudah uh hi.
Haksakna na tuah ciangin na lung a kiat leh, a gina lo mi na hi hi.
Thah dinga a kikai khia mipa honkhia in la, sih nading mun a zuan mipa leh kaih in.
Ke’n thei kha kei ing, na cih nop hangin, lungsim a thei Pasian in tel veve a, nang hong encik Pasian in hong tel theihna phawk in; mi khempeuh a gamtatna bangin thukkik ding hi.
Ka ta aw, khuaizu khum ahih manin ne in; khuailuzu in i kam-ah khum mahmah hi.
Pilna in i nuntakna ah khuaizu tawh kibang a, pilna nei lecin mai lamah lametna om a, na khan’ hong sausak ding hi.
Migilote’ gamtat bangin, thuman mite’ omna sugawp kei in la, amau’ teen’na inn luhgawp kei in.
Mihoihte, sagih vei dong a puk hangin thokik kik thei a, migilote ahih leh tuahsiatna tuakin kithallot hi.
Na galte in gimna a ngah ciangin lungdam kei in la, a puk uh ciangin kipak kei in.
Bang hang hiam cih leh, Topa in hong thei-in nang tungah lungkim lo ding a, na galte tungah heh tat nawn lo kha ding hi.
Migilote hangin na lung nuammawh sak kei in la, amaute eng kha kei in.
Amaute in mai lamah lamet ding bangmah nei lo hi; amaute’ meivak kisukmitsak ding hi.
Ka ta aw, Topa leh kumpipa zahtak khawm in la, amau a langpangte tawh kipawl kha kei in.
Tua bang mite thakhat thu-in kisugawp thei ding hi. Pasian leh kumpipa’ pian’sak theih ding gimna, kuamah in genkhol thei lo hi.
Mipilte’ thugen dangte in: Mi langmuh-a thukhenna hoih lo hi.
Mimawh kim lai a diksak thukhenpa, leitunga mi khempeuh in mudahin phuisam ding hi.
A mawh mi daan a pia thukhenpa ahih leh, thupha kipia-in a dau pai ding hi.
A man tak-a dawn’kikna in, lawm taktak hihna lim ahi hi.
Na nuntak nading zong masa in la, na an nek ding a kicin’ ciang bekin, na inn ding lamin zi leh ta nei pan in.
Thu kician om lopi-in na vengpa langkhatah teci pang kei in la, ama siat nadingin zuauthu gen kei in.
Kei tunga hong bawl bangin kei zong ka bawl ding a, ama hong hihna bangin ka thuk ding hi, ci kha kei in.
Mi thadahpa’ lo gei-ah ka va pai a, mihaipa’ leenggui lo ka nawk kha hi;
ka et ciangin a locing bup-ah kiak dim a, a leitang khempeuh lopa in khuh a, a umna a phungcian’ suangte kicim khin hi.
Tua bang ka muh ciangin thu ka lungngai a, thu manpha khat ka mukhia hi.
Tawmkhat ihmutna, tawmkhat lusukna, tawmkhat sung na sem loin khut zepna hangin,
i tungah zawn’na hong tung a, cihmawhna in hong khuhcip hi.
